relationships.subject: tetrodotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: TTX-sensitive VGSCs (NaV1.1, NaV1.2, NaV1.3, NaV1.4, NaV1.6 and NaV1.7) are blocked by nanomolar concentrations of this neurotoxin

relationships.subject: nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, it has been shown a massive upregulation of the expression of the TTX-sensitive VGSC NaV1.3 in peripheral sensory neurons following nerve injury

relationships.subject: nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: it has been described that they are downregulated in DRG after nerve injury

relationships.subject: tetrodotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: In summary, the systemic or local treatment with TTX has shown efficacy in reducing pain-like behaviors in several animal models of neuropathic pain of different etiology.

key_findings: Review: TTX shows analgesic efficacy in preclinical neuropathic and cancer pain models and is in clinical trials.
Nav1.3, Nav1.6 and Nav1.7 implicated in neuropathic pain; Nav1.8/1.9 reported downregulated after injury.
